task.description:
Step 3 of WF-03: implement the fix per design at src/design/fix-iss0112.md. The design prescribes 5 changes: (1) corrective migration GBL-105 (idempotent); (2) applier guard with force_reconcile param in src/db/migrations.zig; (3) per-test isolation refactor in tests/integration/helpers.zig; (4) tools/clean_test_db.py --include-fixtures flag; (5) tools/verify_schema_baseline.py (new). Implement, run fn:check-zig-build and fn:apply-migrations, then commit + push. This is the implementation step — touch only files listed in design. After zig build exits 0 and zig build migrate exits 0, run `python tools/verify_schema_baseline.py` (newly created tool) to confirm baseline matches.

REWORK 1 (TEST-RUNNER FAIL):
- 19 integration binaries failed to compile because Migrations.runForSchema signature was changed (added force_reconcile: bool as 5th arg) but 3 call sites in tests/integration/ still pass 4 args.
- Specifically: tests/integration/helpers.zig:181, tests/integration/audit_iss103_test.zig:44, tests/integration/exp103_instance_waits_test.zig:81.
- Fix: update these 3 call sites to pass  alse (5th arg). Alternatively, change Migrations.runForSchema to make force_reconcile optional by providing two overloads or a wrapper.
- Design-checker missed this because grep only checked src/, not tests/integration/.

Acceptance criteria for rework:
  - All 3 call sites updated (helpers.zig:181, audit_iss103_test.zig:44, exp103_instance_waits_test.zig:81)
  - zig build exits 0 (no compile errors in any binary)
  - zig build test-integration exits 0 OR compiles all binaries (individual test failures from infra drift acceptable; compile must be clean)
  - Commit + push
  - handoff result.status == PASS

REWORK 2 (TEST-RUNNER FAIL on step 5b):
- 461 integration test failures remain after compile was fixed.
- Root cause: ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence requires (tenant_type='test') -> (production_tenant_id IS NOT NULL).
- helpers.zig:362 INSERT sets tenant_type='test' without providing production_tenant_id.
- Fix: at helpers.zig:362 either (a) include production_tenant_id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid in the INSERT, OR (b) change tenant_type from test to production (which the prior comment says is wrong for cleanup semantics).
- Recommended fix: (a) - add production_tenant_id column with the default-tenant UUID itself, satisfying ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence while preserving tenant_type='test' for clean_test_db.py filter semantics.
- Also: clean_test_db.py may need a tweak if the production_tenant_id FK is now violated by other test tenants.

Acceptance criteria for rework 2:
  - ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence constraint satisfied for the default fixture tenant (production_tenant_id IS NOT NULL where tenant_type='test')
  - helpers.zig:362 INSERT includes production_tenant_id
  - zig build exits 0
  - zig build test-integration compiles all binaries
  - Re-running the iss503 pre-flight test no longer fails on the ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence constraint
  - Commit + push
  - handoff result.status == PASS
